name: Admin Diagnostic NDA Download
description: Admin downloads the final or draft confidentiality PDF from Documents without opening a window or leaving the diagnostic. The browser saves the server filename. Download controls appear only when an agreement exists. Original attachments also download directly; supported previews stay in the existing modal.
knownGaps: NDA-specific E2E error/failure cases are not duplicated here; the shared download controller has HTTP, invalid-response and network tests and the proposal flow exercises recovery in the browser.
